page.title: Service plans
page.subtitle: Manage service plans, their pricing and whether shops can see them.
page.introBody: The “default commission track” is how every individual owner joins — always on, cannot be turned off, and there is only one. The other plans are shop plans sold by VEHICLE TYPE (motorbike or car) and the number of vehicles of that type, plus one enterprise plan covering both types, sold through sales. Turning a plan off only blocks NEW purchases; running subscriptions keep their locked price and limits until the term ends.

page.defaultTrackStatusHint: The default entry for every individual owner — always active, cannot be turned off, and there is never a second commission tier.

confirm.deactivateBody: Shops will no longer be able to buy this plan, and admins cannot assign it to other shops. Subscriptions already running on it keep their locked-in price and limits until the term ends.

confirm.publishBody: The plan appears on the shop price list and can be bought right away at the saved prices. Double-check each term's price before putting it on sale.

form.subtitleCreate: Set up a new plan with its pricing and limits for shops.
form.subtitleEdit: Update the plan details, pricing and limits for shops.
form.subtitleDuplicate: Create a new plan from “{name}” — set a code and name, and review the prices before saving.
form.packageIntro: Prepaid shop plan by vehicle type: no per-trip commission (H = 0). Customers still pay the fixed platform fee S per booking, and tax T is still withheld from the owner’s amount as on every trip. The shop picks a tier matching its fleet size, pays up front by term, and unlocks the full management toolset.
form.commissionIntro: Default commission track: the entry for every individual owner, no subscription fee. On each booking the customer pays the fixed platform fee S; the owner bears the tiered daily commission H and tax T, both deducted from the owner’s amount — the exact rates are set by the active Fee policy.
form.codeHint: The permanent identifier of the plan: lowercase letters without accents, digits and dashes, 2–50 characters. Uppercase, accents and spaces are fine — they are converted automatically, e.g. “VIP Plan 1” becomes “vip-plan-1”. It cannot be changed after creation.
form.name: Plan name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: A short description shops see on the pricing table
form.defaultTrackInfo: The default entry track for individual owners (up to 3 vehicles). No subscription fee. Per-trip commission is set in the Fee policy.
form.salesOnlyHint: Shops cannot buy it themselves; an admin assigns it with the negotiated price. The plan has no listed price — the shop pricing table shows a “Contact sales” button instead.
form.recommendedHint: Highlights this plan on the pricing table shops see.
form.pricingHint: Leave a term empty = that term is not sold. The saving percentage compares against buying month by month at the 1-month price — display only, never written to an invoice.
form.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers come first on the pricing table and in this list.
form.deleteConfirmBody: This plan has never been assigned or bought, so it can be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

validation.codePattern: The plan code needs 2–50 characters (letters, digits, dashes)

form.vehicleScopeHint: The plan only caps vehicles of the selected type: a shop can hold one motorbike plan and one car plan at the same time; an “All vehicle types” plan covers both and excludes them. The vehicle limit counts within this type only. Cannot be changed after creation.
